The '''Tx-2 power generator''' was a model of [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] manufactured by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. They were used on [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors']] [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car]] although it had trouble powering the craft's [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].<ref name="EGVV" />
